title: 沉管隧道預製與浮運
summary: 本課以整合沉管預製質量、浮力、穩性與海事介面為主線，從預製體積與結構質量與排水體積與浮力平衡建立系統邊界，再把吃水變化與水線面、預製溫度與節段變形連到浮運放行與資料一致性。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
summaryEn: This course focuses on integrate immersed-tube fabrication mass, buoyancy, stability and marine interfaces. It begins with Fabrication volume and structural mass and Displacement and buoyancy balance, links Draft change and waterplane area and Fabrication temperature and segment deformation, and ends with Flotation release and record consistency. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預製體積與結構質量」與「排水體積與浮力平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fabrication volume and structural mass" and "Displacement and buoyancy balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預製體積與結構質量」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fabrication volume and structural mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。公噸是質量而非力，受力計算還需重力加速度；材料密度與實際幾何誤差應分開追蹤，才可判斷預測吃水差異來源。 判別這個機制時，應觀察把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳；若出現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預製體積與結構質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. Tonnes measure mass rather than force; force calculations also require gravity. Track density and geometry errors separately to diagnose differences between predicted and observed draft. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fabrication volume and structural mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預製體積與結構質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fabrication volume and structural mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. Tonnes measure mass rather than force; force calculations also require gravity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「沉管隧道預製與浮運」的「預製體積與結構質量：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「都會地下工區協調」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Fabrication volume and structural mass: mechanism and system paths” in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban underground coordination” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「預製體積與結構質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fabrication volume and structural mass" is correct?
options: 管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量
浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。
能漂浮就代表管節遇到傾斜一定能自行恢復
optionsEn: Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass
Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone.
A floating element necessarily returns upright after any inclination
quiz.explanation: 浮運計算需要所有混凝土、鋼材、設備和臨時構件的質量，不能只採名義混凝土體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Flotation needs the mass of concrete, steel, equipment and temporary works, not nominal concrete volume alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預製體積與結構質量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fabrication volume and structural mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預製體積與結構質量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fabrication volume and structural mass", which statement holds?
options: 加水壓載一定只會改善而不會降低穩性
浮體整體浮力平衡就足以證明封艙板安全
原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。
optionsEn: Adding water ballast always improves stability and can never reduce it
Global buoyancy balance is sufficient to prove bulkhead safety
Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: structuralMass=volume*density=25000 m3*2.4 t/m3=60000 t. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預製體積與結構質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fabrication volume and structural mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
knowledge.textEn: Apply the following check at handover: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預製體積與結構質量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fabrication volume and structural mass"?
options: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
平均水流阻力小就能保證所有拖航動態荷載都小
optionsEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Low mean current drag guarantees small loads in every towing dynamic event
quiz.explanation: 把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預製體積與結構質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fabrication volume and structural mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預製體積與結構質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fabrication volume and structural mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：判別這個機制時，應觀察把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳；若出現臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管節混凝土圖說體積就能代表全部浮運質量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Drawing concrete volume alone represents the entire flotation mass" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 臨時設備未入帳讓實際吃水增加，預計乾舷餘裕消失。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到把分段體積、材料密度與設備增減連結到質量帳，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Unrecorded temporary equipment increases draft and consumes expected freeboard. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to link segment volumes, densities and equipment changes to the mass ledger to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 排水體積與浮力平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Displacement and buoyancy balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水體積與浮力平衡」如何影響沉管隧道預製與浮運的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Displacement and buoyancy balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Immersed-tube prefabrication and flotation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靜浮時浮力等於總重量，所需排水體積由總質量除水密度得到。海水密度隨鹽度和溫度變化，內部進水還會同時改變質量與自由液面；平衡只說明垂直合力，不保證遇擾動後會回復原姿態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察將實測水密度、吃水及質量帳共同檢核浮力平衡；若出現沿用錯誤水密度造成吃水預測偏差，局部淨距不足，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水體積與浮力平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At static flotation buoyancy balances total weight, giving displacement as mass divided by water density. Salinity and temperature change density, while internal flooding changes mass and free surfaces. Vertical balance alone does not establish restoration after a disturbance or a safe marine operation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check measured water density and draft against the mass ledger. If incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Displacement and buoyancy balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「能漂浮就代表管節遇到傾斜一定能自行恢復」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A floating element necessarily returns upright after any inclination" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水體積與浮力平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Displacement and buoyancy balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: At static flotation buoyancy balances total weight, giving displacement as mass divided by water density. Salinity and temperature change density, while internal flooding changes mass and free surfaces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：能漂浮就代表管節遇到傾斜一定能自行恢復 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A floating element necessarily returns upright after any inclination Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水體積與浮力平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Displacement and buoyancy balance" is correct?
options: 能漂浮就代表管節遇到傾斜一定能自行恢復
總重量不變就代表浮體穩性完全不變
靜浮時浮力等於總重量，所需排水體積由總質量除水密度得到。
optionsEn: A floating element necessarily returns upright after any inclination
Unchanged total mass means flotation stability is completely unchanged
At static flotation buoyancy balances total weight, giving displacement as mass divided by water density.
quiz.explanation: 靜浮時浮力等於總重量，所需排水體積由總質量除水密度得到。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At static flotation buoyancy balances total weight, giving displacement as mass divided by water density. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水體積與浮力平衡：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水體積與浮力平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Displacement and buoyancy balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3。浮力平衡不代表穩性或可操作性，拖航與沉放需專業海事計畫。 此結果僅用來核對量綱及模型敏感度，不是專案設計值、實測紀錄或現場允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: displacement=mass/rho=60000 t/(1.025 t/m3)=58536.6 m3. Buoyancy balance does not establish stability or operability; towing and immersion require specialist marine plans. This checks dimensions and model sensitivity; it is neither measured project data nor a design or acceptance value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將實測水密度、吃水及質量帳共同檢核浮力平衡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check measured water density and draft against the mass ledger.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 排水體積與浮力平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Displacement and buoyancy balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水體積與浮力平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Displacement and buoyancy balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將實測水密度、吃水及質量帳共同檢核浮力平衡。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「沿用錯誤水密度造成吃水預測偏差，局部淨距不足」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check measured water density and draft against the mass ledger. Retain position, time and datums for comparable repeats, specifically distinguishing this scenario: Incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance. Instrument checks and uncertainty estimates precede interpretation; the responsible engineer sets acceptance and hold points for this test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將將實測水密度、吃水及質量帳共同檢核浮力平衡列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現沿用錯誤水密度造成吃水預測偏差，局部淨距不足，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply the following check at handover: Check measured water density and draft against the mass ledger. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沿用錯誤水密度造成吃水預測偏差，局部淨距不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incorrect water density biases draft prediction and leaves insufficient local clearance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 將實測水密度、吃水及質量帳共同檢核浮力平衡。量測須保存位置、時間及基準，讓同條件的重複結果可比較；並特別檢查「沿用錯誤水密度造成吃水預測偏差，局部淨距不足」是否能由這組資料區分。儀器校核與誤差估計應先於判讀，由負責技師核定該項試驗的允收和停留點。
knowledge.textEn: Check measured water density and draft against the mass ledger.
